name: Front Mount Intercooler Kit
description: Upgraded intercooler to reduce intake temperatures and maintain consistent power during heat soak.
technicalDescription: Larger bar-and-plate core vs OEM, improved charge-air cooling efficiency, reinforced end tanks, bolt-on mounting brackets and couplers (kit dependent).

name: KTuner V2 (ECU Calibration Tool)
description: Tuning device to load ECU calibrations and improve throttle response and power delivery.
technicalDescription: OBD-based ECU calibration + datalogging. Supports multiple maps (license/tune dependent). Adjusts boost/timing/fueling/throttle mapping (engine dependent).

name: 4-2-1 Stainless Performance Headers
description: Improves exhaust scavenging and mid-range performance compared to restrictive stock manifold.
technicalDescription: Stainless 4-2-1 header layout with tuned runner lengths and collector. Typically requires new gaskets and proper bolt torque sequence for leak-free install.

name: OpenFlash Tablet (OFT) ECU Tune Tool
description: Handheld ECU flashing tool used to load optimized maps and improve drivability.
technicalDescription: ECU flash + logging via tablet. Supports OTS maps and custom tuning (platform dependent). Tune changes can adjust throttle, fueling and timing targets.

name: Intercooler + Hard Pipe Kit
description: Cooling upgrade to maintain lower intake temps under load.
technicalDescription: Larger intercooler core with improved flow, aluminum hard piping (kit dependent), reduces pressure drop and stabilizes intake temperatures during sustained boost.

name: Performance Suspension Lift Kit (Springs + Shocks)
description: Improves ride control and stance for mixed city + off-road use.
technicalDescription: Matched springs and dampers tuned for added travel and load handling. Lift height varies by kit and vehicle condition; alignment recommended after install.

name: High-Flow Catted Downpipe
description: Reduces exhaust restriction for quicker spool and stronger mid-range torque.
technicalDescription: Stainless downpipe with high-flow sport catalytic converter (option dependent). Larger diameter than OEM. Best used with ECU calibration to manage emissions and engine light behavior.

name: OTS ECU Tune (License + OBD Flash)
description: Software tune that increases power while keeping factory-like driveability when done correctly.
technicalDescription: OBD ECU flash platform with OTS maps (availability depends on ECU). Includes logging and map management features (license dependent). Supports custom tuning workflow.

name: Upgraded Aluminum Charge Pipes (Boost Pipe Kit)
description: Replaces weak factory plastic charge pipes to prevent boost leaks and failures under higher boost.
technicalDescription: Mandrel aluminum charge pipe set with reinforced couplers and clamps. Rated for higher boost pressures; install requires careful hose routing and clamp torque.

name: Forged Pistons Set (High Performance)
description: Built-engine pistons for higher compression and boost reliability and sustained high RPM use.
technicalDescription: Forged aluminum pistons (alloy varies by spec), upgraded wrist pins, tighter weight matching, designed to handle increased cylinder pressures compared to cast pistons. Requires correct bore sizing and ring gap setup.

name: Performance Camshafts (Pair)
description: Upgraded cams to improve airflow and top-end power for performance builds.
technicalDescription: Higher lift and longer duration compared to OEM (spec dependent). Often requires upgraded valve springs and retainers and ECU tuning for proper idle and power delivery.
